source.description: Original URL of the clipped or referenced content

title.description: Title of the note or clipped article

type.description: Category of the note (tool, article, clipping, moc, research-note...)

domain.description: Knowledge domain the note belongs to (e.g. agent-orchestration)

created.description: Date the note was created in the vault

summary.description: Short editorial summary written by the curator

questions.description: Open questions raised by the content

entities.description: Notable people, organizations, or tools mentioned

schema_version.description: Version of the frontmatter schema used by this note
